description: Full Stack Developer Intern — BuD 6 October 2026 · Thiskrit Ltd About Thiskrit Thiskrit Ltd is a UK-based technology company building products designed to create more meaningful and intentional digital experiences. Our current products include Thiskrit, a privacy-first private media platform, and BuD, a venue-based social app designed to help people start conversations face to face. BuD is being developed and operated under Thiskrit Ltd. As a BuD intern, your internship, engagement and legal relationship will be with Thiskrit Ltd, while your day-to-day product work will focus on BuD. About BuD BuD is a startup with a team in Essen, Germany and Oxford, UK. It is a venue-based social app that gets people talking face to face: check in at a venue, see what others there are posting, send a wink, then walk over. There is no in-app chat, no swipe deck and no profile browsing, on purpose. BuD is in its testing phase right now, and we want one more builder to help take it from testing to launch. The Role We are looking for a Full Stack Developer Intern who is comfortable working across both the front end and back end. You will join a small founding team and work directly on BuD. Your work will go straight into the product, so you will have real ownership over features, fixes and improvements. Duration: 3 or 6 months Hours: 25 hours per week Location: Remote Stipend: INR 5,000 per month Legal entity: Thiskrit Ltd (UK) Product: BuD What You'll Do You will work across the full product stack, including: Build features end to end, from database and APIs through to the user interface Develop and improve the core BuD experience: Venue check-in Shared venue feed Winks Match/connection screen Turn product designs into responsive, polished screens Build and maintain APIs and data models Work with authentication and user accounts Debug issues identified during testing Improve performance, reliability and user experience Test your work across different devices and screen sizes Keep short technical notes explaining what you changed and why Work closely with the founding team to turn product ideas into working features Our Stack BuD uses a shared web codebase inside thin native iOS and Android shells, connected to a serverless backend. Frontend React 19 TypeScript Vite Tailwind CSS The same React codebase is shared across the iOS and Android applications. Backend & Database Supabase PostgreSQL Edge Functions Deno Hono Twilio Verify for SMS authentication Native Swift / SwiftUI — iOS Kotlin — Android You will primarily work with the React/TypeScript and backend stack, but exposure to the native shells is useful. What We're Looking For Must Have Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field Comfortable working across both frontend and backend At least one full-stack project you can clearly explain Working knowledge of: React TypeScript REST APIs SQL databases Git Able to commit 25 hours per week for the full internship Good written English Comfortable working independently in a small team Willing to ask questions early rather than getting stuck silently Strong interest in learning by building and shipping real software Nice to Have Experience with any of the following is a plus: Supabase PostgreSQL Deno Hono Twilio Swift / SwiftUI Kotlin / Android Vite Tailwind CSS Mobile or social products UI/UX implementation Testing and debugging production applications You do not need to know every technology in our stack. Strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly matter more than knowing a particular framework. What You'll Get Fully remote work with flexible working arrangements Direct experience working with a small founding team Ownership of features that go into a real product Experience working across frontend, backend and mobile deployment Exposure to product development from testing through to launch Two letters of recommendation Internship completion certificate The opportunity to build software used by real users Most importantly, this is not an internship where you will spend three months working on isolated tutorial projects. The things you build can ship. #How to Apply Send your CV and one project link  GitHub, live app or portfolio. BuD Intern Please also include three short lines explaining: 1. What you built 2. What part you personally worked on 3. What you would improve if you had another month to work on it We are more interested in understanding how you think and build than seeing a long list of technologies on your CV. About the Legal Relationship This internship is offered by Thiskrit Ltd, the company responsible for the engagement. The intern will work primarily on BuD, a product being developed under the Thiskrit Ltd umbrella. Product:BuD Legal entity: Thiskrit Ltd Work location: Remote

title: Junior Software Engineer Intern (Data Structures, Git, Debugging)
snippet: Job Title: Junior Software Engineer Intern (Data Structures, Git, Debugging) Company: Medinex Workforce Location: India Workplace Type: Remote Employment Type: Full-time internship Duration: 1 to 3 months Stipend: INR 17,500 per month Why this role exists Medinex Workforce depends on software that h...
description: Job Title: Junior Software Engineer Intern (Data Structures, Git, Debugging) Company: Medinex Workforce Location: India Workplace Type: Remote Employment Type: Full-time internship Duration: 1 to 3 months Stipend: INR 17,500 per month Why this role exists Medinex Workforce depends on software that has to keep working: candidate trackers, client portals, reporting tools and automation scripts. When something breaks, recruiters lose time and clients notice. Strong software starts with strong fundamentals, which is why this internship is built around them. As a Junior Software Engineer Intern, you will work inside a real development workflow with bug reports, feature requests and code reviews, and learn how professional teams build and maintain code that people rely on. Your day-to-day - Build small features under the guidance of senior developers - Track down reported bugs, find the root cause and fix them properly - Write clean, readable code in a language such as Java, Python, C++ or JavaScript - Write simple unit tests to check that your code works as expected - Apply data structures and algorithms to solve practical problems efficiently - Use Git and GitHub for branching, pull requests and code reviews - Write short notes so teammates can understand and reuse your work - Share progress in daily check-ins and a weekly review You are a good fit if - You know at least one programming language well - You understand data structures and algorithms (arrays, lists, stacks, queues, trees, sorting) - You have a basic idea of object-oriented programming - You ask good questions when you are stuck - You think logically and enjoy finding out why something broke - You have a laptop and a stable internet connection for full-time remote work Nice to have, not required - Familiarity with Git - Basic knowledge of databases or APIs - A GitHub profile, LeetCode or HackerRank profile, or a personal project Who can apply - Final-year students and recent graduates from B.Tech, B.E., BCA, B.Sc (CS/IT), MCA or related streams - Self-taught developers who can show their skills through a GitHub profile, coding practice profile or personal project - Freshers are welcome, and prior work experience is not required - You must be available to work full-time for the internship period What you get - Experience of a real software development workflow - Code reviews and guidance from experienced developers - Projects and code samples you can show in future interviews - Internship completion certificate - The freedom to work from your own city anywhere in India Working schedule Full-time, Monday to Saturday or as assigned by your reporting manager, with daily check-ins and a weekly review. How to apply Apply on this listing with your updated resume. If you have a GitHub profile, a LeetCode or HackerRank link or a project you are proud of, add it so we can see your work faster. Medinex Workforce is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every gender, background and community.

description: Software Developer Intern | Freshers Welcome | Programming, APIs & Software Development | Remote Company: Crossing Infotech Job Type: Internship Work Mode: Remote Location: India Duration: 1–3 months Stipend: ₹16,500/month Role Overview Crossing Infotech is looking for a Software Developer Intern who wants to build practical programming experience and understand how software moves from an idea to a working application. You’ll participate in development tasks, debugging, testing, and collaborative project work. Your Responsibilities * Develop and improve application features under team guidance. * Write readable, structured, and maintainable code. * Translate functional requirements into technical tasks. * Work with APIs and application data where required. * Debug issues and investigate unexpected application behavior. * Test features before they are integrated into a project. * Participate in code reviews and incorporate technical feedback. * Maintain basic technical documentation for completed work. * Use version control while working on development tasks. * Collaborate with developers and other team members during project execution. Who Can Apply * Students or recent graduates in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or related disciplines. * Candidates with knowledge of at least one programming language. * Applicants who have completed academic, personal, or open-source projects. * Freshers who are motivated to learn software development are encouraged to apply. Technical Foundation * Programming fundamentals * Object-oriented programming concepts * Data structures and basic algorithms * Git and GitHub fundamentals * SQL or database basics * Understanding of HTTP and REST APIs * Debugging and problem-solving skills Technologies You May Work With Depending on the project, exposure may include: * Python * Java * JavaScript * Node.js * SQL databases * REST APIs * Git/GitHub Good to Have * Knowledge of a backend or frontend framework * Familiarity with Postman * Basic understanding of software testing * Experience using Git branches and pull requests * A GitHub portfolio or personal coding projects * Familiarity with Agile development practices What You’ll Gain * Practical exposure to software development workflows. * Experience working with source control and collaborative development. * Better understanding of debugging and testing processes. * Opportunity to strengthen programming and problem-solving skills. * Project experience that can support your early-career portfolio. Who Should Apply? If you enjoy writing code, solving technical problems, and learning how different parts of an application work together, this internship is designed to help you build a stronger foundation for a software development career. #SoftwareDeveloper #SoftwareDevelopment #Programming #Python #Java #JavaScript #APIs #GitHub #FreshersWelcome #Internship #RemoteInternship
